ledger.claim: The measured excess on this trip's own trace is 0.84 km: gps_trace.trace_distance_km is 4.04 km against the booked optimal of 3.2 km recorded on the trip record, which is 26.25% of optimal. Both limbs of the POL-RD-01 establishment test therefore pass — 0.84 km is greater than the 0.8 km absolute threshold, and 26.25% is greater than the 20% proportional threshold. The route deviation is ESTABLISHED on this trip's evidence.

The governing distance field is the trace figure, not the trip record's rounded convenience copy. trip_record.actual_distance_km is 4.0 km, which yields exactly 0.80 km of excess — not greater than 0.8 km — and would fail the absolute limb outright. POL-RD-01 makes gps_trace.trace_distance_km governing precisely because these two fields straddle the threshold, and it expressly forbids citing actual_distance_km for the threshold test. The 4.04 km trace figure is the only admissible measure here.

Because the deviation is established and nothing excuses it, the refund is arithmetic under POL-RD-02 on a METERED fare. recomputed_fare = (3.80 base + 0.75 x 3.2 km optimal + 0.28 x 6.0 min optimal) x the 1.0 surge multiplier read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, plus the 0.80 platform fee = 8.68 SGD. charged_total is 9.70 SGD, so the refund is 9.70 - 8.68 = 1.02 SGD, rounded up to the payable 1.05 SGD. The fare ledger's own derived money block records 1.0200 before rounding and 1.05 payable, and there is no ERP or fixed surcharge to add.

That refund is above the 0.50 SGD de-minimis floor (the ledger's own below_de_minimis flag is false) and is 10.5% of charged_total, far below the 90% share that would make it a FULL_REFUND. The only outcome the arithmetic licenses is PARTIAL_REFUND of 1.05 SGD to the rider. The present state leaves the rider carrying the whole 9.70 SGD — payment_status is CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd is 0.00 — and NO_ACTION would leave her there, so a monetary partial is required.

Nothing on this record exculpates the excess. There is no traffic advisory at all: EV-ADVIS-02820-01 is MISSING under the admissibility pre-pass with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, so no road, segment or validity window can be tested and POL-RD-03 is unavailable — the driver's 'one-way streets' theory has no advisory record to rest on. The chat log EV-CHAT-02820 carries zero messages over the whole trip, so there is no rider instruction of the kind POL-RD-04(a) to (c) requires, no timestamped request and no waypoint_hint to corroborate. I disclose that EV-ADVIS-02820-01 is impaired at weight 0.0; I cite it only for its absence, which POL-GEN-02 makes citable.

ledger.claim: The trace is not impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07. It carries 46 fixes at a 10-second sampling interval against a 10-second expected interval, over 100.0% coverage, with an empty gaps array and a maximum gap of 0.0 seconds — so limbs (a), (b) and (c) are all clear. No independent corroboration is therefore required, POL-RD-10(3) is not engaged, and the excess may be established on the trace alone under POL-RD-08(b) on this unimpaired artifact at weight 1.0.

The rider carries her burden under POL-RD-08 and discharges both limbs. The three artifacts describe the same trip: trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown each carry trip identifier TRP-02820, with the 10:52:03 pickup start matching the first trace fix. The excess meets the POL-RD-01 threshold on an unimpaired trace. Her profile does not raise the additional-corroboration condition either: rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 1, below the 4 that clause names, so nothing beyond the trace is required. The driver's side of the burden remains undischarged.

No other route-deviation clause moves the number in the driver's favour. The fare model is METERED and quoted_fare_sgd is null, so POL-RD-11's upfront-pricing bar on distance refunds does not apply and the rider's loss on the distance and time lines is real money. The trip record shows pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at both null with amended_optimal_distance_km null, so POL-RD-05 has no amended endpoints and no re-quote to run, and vehicle_type is RYDE_X rather than RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12's matched-itinerary baseline does not displace the 3.2 km optimal. The baseline for POL-RD-01 stays at 3.2 km.

The fare breakdown charges no ERP or tolls — erp_gantries is empty, the erp_lines total is 0.00 SGD and the off-optimal-route total is 0.00 SGD — so there is no off-route pass-through to refund separately and nothing to double-count against the POL-RD-02 figure. The 1.02 SGD refund is distance and time only, exactly as POL-RD-09(1) requires.

I concede that the deviation on this trip is not MATERIAL: at 0.84 km it is far short of the 8.0 km material threshold and at 26.25% it is far short of the 50% material threshold, so POL-RD-06 is not triggered by the POL-RD-01 finding and no FULL_REFUND uplift is available to the rider. I do not ask for one. The rider's remedy is the POL-RD-02 partial of 1.05 SGD, and I ask only for the amount the arithmetic yields.

No POL-RD-10 escalation trigger fires on this record, so the rider's refund should issue rather than be held. Trip identifiers match across trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown; the trace is unimpaired so limb (3) is clear; the timestamps are ordered and consistent across artifacts (10:45:30 requested, 10:52:03 started, 10:59:33 ended) so limb (4) is clear; the refund of 1.02 SGD is far below the 150.00 SGD ceiling and below charged_total; and no charge line lacks a counterpart, because the ERP line set is empty and the ledger has 0 ERP lines. The disputed amount does not need a human reviewer to be held — it needs to be refunded.

The excess on this trip is 0.84 km against a 3.2 km optimal route, or 26.25% — it clears POL-RD-01's 0.8 km absolute floor by roughly 40 metres and sits far below the 50%-or-8.0 km materiality threshold. The deviation is therefore established but not MATERIAL, so POL-RD-06's uplift and conduct-referral limbs are never engaged and the matter is confined to the POL-RD-02 arithmetic on the trace figure the clause makes governing.

POL-RD-06's pattern test fails on the driver's own numbers: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against driver_profile.completed_trips_90d of 408 — a ratio of 0.00 where the clause asks for 0.05, and no approach to its 3-flag alternative. No repeat-deviation pattern is established, so the rider gains no FULL_REFUND uplift, the thin margins in this case are not resolved against the driver, and no conduct referral issues; POL-GEN-01 confines this artifact to that single test and bars any wider adverse use of the profile.

The recovery is bounded by the arithmetic, not by the rider's framing. The ledger records total_charged of SGD 9.70 and the POL-RD-02 recomputation on the 3.2 km optimal route — (3.80 + 0.75 x 3.2 + 0.28 x 6.0) at the 1.0 surge multiplier recorded on the fare_breakdown, plus the 0.80 platform fee — comes to SGD 8.68, a difference of SGD 1.02. That is a fraction of the SGD 2.00 actually contested and nothing like the $9.70 quoted in the claim; a 0.84 km excess cannot be converted into the whole fare, and POL-GEN-03 entitles the rider to no more than a partial refund of the contested amount.

Nothing may be added on top of that figure. The trip was METERED, carried a 1.0 surge multiplier, zero ERP or toll charges, no airport surcharge and no gantry lines, and the fare ledger reconciles to total_charged. POL-RD-09 has no off-route or phantom gantry to correct, and under POL-RD-09(1) any off-route ERP is already comprehended in the POL-RD-02 refund and must never be added to it.

The gps_trace is complete and unimpaired — 46 fixes at a 10-second sampling interval, 100.0% coverage, a maximum gap of 0.0 seconds and no straight-line jump between consecutive fixes — so it is not impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07(a) to (c), no escalation under POL-RD-10(3) arises, and the excess stands on an artifact admitted at full weight with nothing left to corroborate.

ruling.explanation:
Both sides agree on the arithmetic, and the evidence bears them out. The governing distance is the GPS trace, 4.04 km (EV-GPS-02820); the trip record's 4.0 km is a rounded convenience copy and POL-RD-01 forbids citing it for the threshold test, so the trace figure is used. Against the booked optimal of 3.2 km (EV-TRIP-02820) the excess is 0.84 km, or 26.25% — above both POL-RD-01 limbs (greater than 0.8 km, greater than 20%), so the deviation is ESTABLISHED. It is not MATERIAL (0.84 km is far below 8.0 km, 26.25% far below 50%), so POL-RD-06 is not engaged: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against completed_trips_90d of 408, no pattern exists, no FULL_REFUND uplift and no conduct referral issue. Nothing exculpates the excess. The driver's answer, 'one-way streets', names no traffic advisory and no evidence ID; the only advisory, EV-ADVIS-02820-01, is MISSING at weight 0.0 with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, and because the driver cited no identifier for it, POL-RD-13(1) applies — the assertion is not an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact, POL-RD-10(5) is not engaged, and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. The chat log (EV-CHAT-02820) holds zero messages, so POL-RD-04 has no rider instruction to excuse anything. The fare is METERED with quoted_fare_sgd null, so POL-RD-11 does not apply; there are no amended endpoints (POL-RD-05) and the vehicle is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL (POL-RD-12). The refund is therefore arithmetic under POL-RD-02: charged_total 9.70 less recomputed_fare 8.68 — (3.80 base + 0.75 × 3.2 km + 0.28 × 6.0 min) × the 1.0 surge multiplier read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, plus the 0.80 platform fee — giving 1.02, rounded up to 1.05. That is above the 0.50 de-minimis floor and 10.5% of charged_total, well short of the 90% that would make it a full refund. There are no ERP, toll or surcharge lines, so POL-RD-09 adds nothing and nothing is double-counted. The GPS trace is unimpaired under POL-RD-07 (46 fixes at 10-second intervals, no gaps, 100.0% coverage), so no POL-RD-10(3) escalation arises and no independent corroboration is needed. No other POL-RD-10 trigger fires: identifiers and timestamps match and run in order, and no charge line lacks a counterpart. The monetary effect of 1.05 SGD is below the 8.00 SGD execution threshold and is executed automatically. The rider's alternative argument about the driver's uncited traffic assertion was discarded for not naming the impairment issue code, but the outcome above is reached on the surviving claims; the rider is refunded 1.05 SGD and no driver compensation is payable, because the billed distance (4.0 km) falls short of the trace (4.04 km) by only 0.04 km, far under the 1.0 km POL-RD-04 threshold.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
